{{Top|leg}}
A '''Central Learning Chip''' was a chip used in [[Metrocab Robo-Hack Landspeeder]]s, giving them the ability to learn and remember shortcuts based on the time of day and regular traffic patterns.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
